value.rationale: A complete all-frequency rank and sharp conditioning classification for the canonical proper-colouring family K_{m,n}, not just its chromatic count. It reveals that both shore sizes must be even for extra signal loss, gives an exact finite sum for every lost balanced mode, and finds a sharp 3-to-9 surviving spectral-gap transition; these are natural exact invariants of colour-constrained convolution, not arbitrary finite table entries.
